title: Lighthouse cards: compact scenario snapshots for Optimize onboarding
creator: Maya Chen
description: Design a set of compact, reusable ‘lighthouse’ cards that surface Optimize toolkit recommendations (batching, KV-caching, and quantization) as scenario snapshots for first-run and docs quickstarts. Cards should be modular components usable in the Console onboarding flow, docs pages, and the in-app Optimize sidebar. Each card must clearly communicate expected latency and cost delta, quality trade-offs, and a small ‘why this matters’ tooltip. Deliverables: Figma components + exportable PNG/GIF/MP4 assets + microcopy for each state (recommended / conservative / experimental). Include a compact grid view for the quickstart page and an expanded walkthrough version for the full onboarding modal.
acceptance_criteria: Figma file with a component library: lighthouse-card (compact + expanded) and state variants (recommended, conservative, experimental)
Exported assets: 3 PNG sizes (320x180, 640x360, 1280x720) and one animated GIF showing toggle between caching on/off for docs usage
Microcopy set (title, 1-sentence benefit, tooltip explanation, call-to-action) approved by PM and Eng
Console mock showing placement in first-run quickstart and Optimize sidebar (desktop + tablet)
Accessibility checks: color contrast meets AA; keyboard focus states defined
Implementation-ready handoff: tokens, spacing, copy, and example props for React component
assets: Animated GIF: caching_toggle_walkthrough.gif (showing TTL and cache hit examples)
MP4: quant-profile-toggle.mp4 (60s, narrated) for internal launch demo
dependencies: ENG-7892 (backend telemetry for estimated latency/cost metrics)
